path_story.name: Patwin request through payment and reconciliation
path_story.description: VAC-2026-PATWIN-001. Prototype document review and simulated city execution. Includes optional T7; skips adjustment.

annotations.Task_Formulate: Prepare the fictional $10,000 work package, its department/fund context, and its justification.
annotations.Task_OpenPR: Git supplies the document history and line-item diff. No transaction.
annotations.Task_Review: Structured review summary and comments, with an agency response. No transaction.
annotations.Task_Merge: A configured independent reviewer approves the current head. A verified merge approves the prototype document version, not City spending.
annotations.Task_Propose: Link the exact approved document version and its GitHub evidence. This does not create actual City spending authority.
annotations.Task_Congress: The published $150,575 Patwin row is context. Actual availability and restrictions are not asserted. This remains a fictional work package.
annotations.Task_Authority: T1: Approved prototype request → $10,000 work-package limit. Bind this limit to the exact request version. GitHub document approval does not establish actual City spending authority.
annotations.Task_Apportion: T2: $10,000 → $2,500 released + $7,500 unreleased. The period limit refers to the original authority and its conditions.
annotations.Task_Allot: T3: $2,500 → $1,000 work order + $1,500 unassigned. Check purpose, amount, and approvals before recording the allotment.
annotations.Task_Obligate: T4: $1,000 → $750 committed + $250 uncommitted. The contract remains in its authoritative system; evidence links the obligation to the allotment.
annotations.Task_Accept: Accept actual work before approving the invoice. No blockchain transaction.
annotations.Task_Pay: Actual payment happens in the financial system. The next task attests its record.
annotations.Task_PartialReceipt: T5: $750 → $500 paid + $250 committed/unpaid. Attest the financial-system payment after work acceptance and reconciliation. Marker sats remain in demo custody.
annotations.Task_FinalAccept: Later work acceptance, after the current live snapshot.
annotations.Task_FinalPay: Actual final payment stays in the financial system.
annotations.Task_FinalReceipt: T6: $250 committed/unpaid → $250 paid. This is a later event, beyond the live dashboard snapshot. The final payment occurs in the financial system.
annotations.Task_Reconcile: Reconcile the $750K contract. Account closeout follows its own availability rules.
annotations.Task_Checkpoint: T7: $500 paid + $250 paid → $750 reconciled. Optional checkpoint. Paid markers stay historical; reconciliation does not release fresh budget authority.
